summary_markdown:
An issue was identified where mall analytics for a specific facility (Provanchage) is not displaying data, despite receiving data from the server. While other facilities showed data via [email@allunite.com], Provanchage displayed zero values.

[p1] confirmed that while reviewing the data, the demographic information was not arriving from the server.

It was determined that the code is currently waiting for demographic data to populate the view.
decisions: The analytics dashboard must be fixed so it can display data even if demographic information is unavailable.
action_items: Someone needs to fix the analytics code to handle missing demographic data.
